estimates: The mapped perimeter and covered drive are direct geographic controls. Unmeasured upper heights, dome radius, roof subdivisions and façade spacing are approximate.
The façade finishes and woven motifs are simplified from published descriptions. The scope is the public exterior, including the ceremonial entrance and standing council wings.
The image in the story depicts the original council members in 1959, before construction of the present building. This reconstruction uses written architectural records and mapped shape.

review.notes: Reviewed the original Qualla media first. Its old group portrait does not depict this building. No external image was selected. The model is supported by the contemporary government building description, official opening date, named roof outline and covered entrance trace.
